summary: First-run full backend + frontend test for LocalPrice hyperlocal marketplace. Backend: 27/27 pytest cases pass covering auth (consumer/vendor register, login, role mismatch, /me, logout), vendor product CRUD, trial-unlimited (16+ products), search (filters/sort), click counter, analytics (works during trial and after Pro), branches gating (402 on expired-trial non-pro, 200 after Pro activation), payment mock flow (create-order + verify → is_pro=true + pro_expires_at set), product cap of 15 enforced after simulated trial expiry (mongo trial_started_at back-dated 31d). Frontend: Landing renders with hero+search+consumer/vendor CTAs; Consumer signup redirects to /search and search returns results; Vendor signup lands on /vendor/dashboard with 'Free trial · 30 days left' badge, product/views/clicks/CTR stat cards populated (not locked during trial - matches spec), multi-branch upsell visible; Pricing cards visible; monthly buy click triggers mock verify and toasts 'Pro activated! (demo mode)' → dashboard shifts to 'Pro plan active' with Manage Branches unlocked. Razorpay mock mode confirmed working. No blocking issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py CORS uses allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=True which browsers reject; the app currently works because frontend falls back to Bearer token in localStorage (axios interceptor). If cookie-based auth is desired to work across browsers, replace '*' with explicit origin(s).
pydantic EmailStr rejects reserved TLDs like '.test'. Suggested creds in /app/memory/test_credentials.md use '.test' which will 422. Consider updating docs to use '@qa.example.com' or similar.
compute_trial_status parses pro_expires_at with datetime.fromisoformat but ignores tz-naive strings silently via bare except — acceptable but noisy.

GET /api/search bumps views by update_many on top-50 results even when q is empty (all products in city), which will over-inflate views for browsing. Consider only bumping when q non-empty or capping.
POST /api/products/{id}/click has no auth or rate-limiting → trivially spoofable to inflate a competitor's CTR (or a vendor's own). Consider basic origin/user throttle.

razorpay client init: RAZORPAY_KEY_ID.endswith('placeholder') branch skips only the placeholder default. If a real key is present but RAZORPAY_MODE is left 'mock', mock still runs — expected but log a warning.
test_credentials: Fresh accounts created per run with test_shopper_{uuid}@qa.example.com and test_vendor_{uuid}@qa.example.com, password Test@1234. Suggested docs in /app/memory/test_credentials.md use .test TLD which pydantic EmailStr rejects (422) — update to @qa.example.com.
seed_data_creation: No permanent seed data. Each pytest run creates ephemeral TEST_-prefixed vendor/consumer accounts and products. Teardown intentionally disabled due to pytest-xdist per-worker teardown races; use an external cleanup script if needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (currently https://hyperlocal-deals-6.preview.emergentagent.com). Razorpay is in mock mode; /api/payments/verify auto-approves. pytest.ini enforces -n 2 --dist loadscope so class-scoped state is fine but module-scoped fixtures duplicate per worker (UNIQUE differs per worker). Backend uses EmailStr which rejects '.test' TLD → use @qa.example.com. All 27 tests currently green.
